evals.prompt: 我上传了一份短片剧本，请直接帮我做完整 shotlist 和视频提示词。
evals.expected_output: The first response asks the user to choose Seedance 2.0 or MiniMax H3 and stops before script analysis or asset requests.
expectations: The response contains both exact options: Seedance 2.0 and MiniMax H3.
The response asks for exactly one platform choice.
The response does not analyze the screenplay, request assets, draw blocking, or emit prompt fields.

evals.prompt: 这是同一个任务的下一轮。上一轮你已经完成平台提问，我现在明确选择 Seedance 2.0。剧本：1-1 夜 内，人物林夏。林夏走到桌边，拿起母亲留下的旧照片，低声说：‘我回来了。’请做全场。
evals.expected_output: The skill enters the unchanged Seedance script-reading and asset-request branch, lists the character, location, and photograph, then stops for uploads and scope without H3 syntax.
expectations: The response does not ask for the platform again.
The asset request includes Lin Xia, the interior-night location, and the old photograph.
The response ends with the existing Seedance upload-and-scope instruction.
No H3 top-level fields, H3 reference labels, or H3 mode names appear.

evals.prompt: 继续一个已完成前三阶段的任务：PROMPT_PLATFORM 已锁定为 MiniMax H3；范围为场景 1；资产映射和俯视走位均已批准。suwan.png 是苏晚的可复用人物外观参考，rain_stall.png 是纸鹤摊环境参考，suwan_voice.wav 只参考苏晚的音色与缓慢疲惫的语速，不复制原音频。生成一个 15 秒 Ref2VA HTML 分镜。镜头一：苏晚坐在桌边看着纸鹤；她的画外音是‘我本来不信。’镜头二在 00:07.000 切到她的手部近景，她没有开口，纸鹤轻轻颤动。
evals.expected_output: A MiniMax H3 HTML shotlist with paired Chinese director-storyboard and English six-section prompts. An operator checklist maps suwan_voice.wav to the real <Audio 1> upload slot and Su Wan, while both model-facing prompts contain no audio filename. The Chinese and English prompts both bind <Audio 1> to Su Wan's owning vocal event, use audio reference rather than reuse, and preserve the target Chinese voice-over.
expectations: The Chinese block keeps the five-section director-storyboard structure; an operator checklist outside both prompts maps suwan_voice.wav to <Audio 1> and 苏晚, while 角色与场景 contains one filename-free <Audio 1> binding with Audio mode: audio reference, Retention: reference, scope, and exclusions.
The English companion contains the six sections once and in canonical order: subject_definitions, summary, retention_analysis, detailed_description, overall_soundscape, non_diegetic_music.

The English definition maps <Audio 1> semantically to Su Wan's same stable speaker ID without naming suwan_voice.wav; the summary includes audio reference, and retention uses reference without a speaker ID.

Both prompts cite <Audio 1> at Su Wan's actual vocal event; the Chinese prompt also uses natural-language voice direction. Both retain a complete written voice baseline, and both audio bindings exclude the source words and waveform.
The voice-over uses the exact phrase says in an off-screen voiceover, preserves <d>[Chinese] 我本来不信。</d>, and immediately states that her lips remain completely closed.
Shot 1 has no timestamp; Shot 2 uses 00:07.000; the prompt contains no @imageN, Chinese Seedance scaffolding, warning block, or 15秒。21:9。 footer.
Literal H3 angle-bracket tags are HTML-escaped in the DOM but copy back as their original text.

evals.prompt: 继续一个已完成拆镜和分组的任务。平台无关的 PROMPT_GROUPS 已批准：Group A 包含镜头行 1.1、1.2、1.3，内部是三个连续镜头；Group B 包含镜头行 1.4、1.5。现在选择 MiniMax H3 I2VA；first_frame.png 是每个分组已经批准并映射好的精确首帧。请生成 HTML，不要重新拆分。
evals.expected_output: The H3 renderer preserves the approved two-group manifest exactly and serializes each group's internal shots with I2VA alignment and H3 timeline syntax instead of creating one prompt per shot.
expectations: The HTML contains exactly two copyable H3 prompt blocks, one for Group A and one for Group B.
Group A remains one prompt containing rows 1.1, 1.2, and 1.3 as three ordered internal H3 shots.
Group B remains one prompt containing rows 1.4 and 1.5 in their original order.
The output does not perform an H3-specific split, merge, addition, deletion, or reorder of the approved groups.
Each copyable prompt begins with the exact I2VA first-frame alignment instruction and then uses H3 fields and timed [Shot N] syntax without Seedance-only prompt scaffolding.

evals.prompt: 这是同一个任务的下一轮。我选择 MiniMax H3，但不上传任何图片、视频或音频，直接用文字做全部场景。
evals.expected_output: The skill stops at the H3 asset gate, explains that at least one intended reference input is required, and does not select a fallback mode or generate prompts.
expectations: The response requests at least one valid H3 reference input and asks for its intended role.
The response does not generate H3 prompt fields or an HTML shotlist.
The response does not offer a text-only or no-upload fallback.

evals.prompt: 继续一个前三阶段均已批准的 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA 任务。场景1-1：苏晚独自走进凌晨雨夜老街；suwan_character.png 锁定苏晚身份与服装，old_street_rain.png 锁定场景。原文旁白为：‘网上说，凌晨三点，雨不太大也不太小的时候，老街尽头会有一个纸鹤摊。只开十分钟。’请生成一个不超过15秒的导演化测试片段。
evals.expected_output: A bilingual Ref2VA clip that turns the voice-over into a progression from environmental uncertainty to private recognition, using only the two visible references, motivated framing/focus/cuts, closed lips, synchronized rain/footsteps, and a stable landing frame.
expectations: Only Su Wan and the rain-soaked old street are defined as reference subjects; the output does not pad the prompt with stall, old man, crane, skyline, or other unused subjects.
The exact voice-over text and punctuation appear inside d payloads without a character-name prefix, colon, quotation marks, timing text, or stage directions.
The visible Su Wan's lips remain completely closed throughout the off-screen voice-over.
Every internal shot states framing and crop, camera height or angle, screen geography, focus, motivated camera behavior, action progression, and a stable landing state.
Every cut is motivated by gaze, semantic information, action, or focus transfer; the shots progress from space to recognition instead of repeating three generic rainy images.
The final readable pose holds for at least 0.8 seconds and non_diegetic_music is exactly N/A in both language versions.
Because no real audio reference was requested, neither prompt contains <Audio N>, Audio mode, audio reference, audio reuse, or an audio Retention line.

evals.prompt: 继续一个前三阶段均已批准的 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA 任务。场景1-2：老人位于蓝布北侧朝南，苏晚位于南侧朝北，相距约1.8米，180度轴线已锁定。仅使用 suwan_character.png、oldman_character.png、paper_crane_stall.png、paper_cranes_set.png。原文台词：苏晚‘真能飞到？’；老人‘上一个客人。父亲走了四年，她今年刚考上研究生。’纸鹤从掌心真实地颤动、展开并飞起。请生成一个不超过15秒的测试片段。
evals.expected_output: A bilingual Ref2VA relationship scene that establishes geography, uses a necessary crane insert without breaking the axis, directs a physically causal paper-flight action, transfers focus through doubt/proof/reaction, and preserves restrained speaker/listener performance.
expectations: Exactly four genuinely visible reference units are defined; hair, clothing, pose, expression, camera style, and action are not split into extra subjects.
The first vocal event is Su Wan as S1 and the second speaker is the old man as S2; each d payload contains only the exact audible source words.
The two-person coverage preserves north/south facing, about 1.8 meters of distance, screen-left/right positions, eyelines, foreground occlusion, and the approved 180-degree axis.

The crane insert is retained inside the same dramatic unit and shows a causal chain from stillness through rain disturbance, fold movement, weight shift, lift, and stable flight without magic particles or glowing effects.
Cuts transfer attention from doubt to physical proof to the old man's calm account and Su Wan's restrained reaction; no cut exists merely because a lens changes.
The old man's delivery is everyday and factual rather than mystical, Su Wan reacts with gaze/breath/eyelid changes rather than an exaggerated gasp, and the final state holds at least 0.8 seconds.

evals.prompt: 继续一个前三阶段均已批准的 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA 任务。场景1-3始终停留在纸鹤摊现实层，不插医院闪回。只使用 suwan_character.png、oldman_character.png、paper_crane_stall.png。原文台词：苏晚‘她走那天，我迟到了。医院打电话说她快不行了，我在开会，手机静音。’老人全程沉默。请生成一个不超过15秒、以演员表演完整性为优先的测试片段。
evals.expected_output: A bilingual Ref2VA confession clip that chooses a motivated continuous take or the fewest necessary cuts, preserves both thought units and exact transcript, directs one-at-a-time micro-performance and listener response, and ends in audible/visible emotional residue rather than a mechanical dialogue cut.
expectations: The two sentences remain in source order and exact punctuation, with Su Wan as the first and only vocal speaker S1; the silent old man receives no speaker ID.
The clip remains at the paper-crane stall in one time and reality layer and does not visualize the hospital phone call as a flashback.
The shot plan is justified by the dramatic unit: a 5-14 second uninterrupted take or necessary short insert is accepted and no cut is manufactured to satisfy a default shot count.

Performance progresses in observable order: pen tip stops, incomplete inhale, gaze stays on paper, first sentence lands, pause/swallow, second sentence loses support, post-line breath and silence remain.
The old man's listening is visible but restrained and timed after Su Wan's turn; he does not nod repeatedly, interrupt, or steal focus.
The final pen/rain/silence residue and stable pose last at least 0.8 seconds, while non_diegetic_music remains exactly N/A.

evals.prompt: 继续一个已锁定 MiniMax H3 Ref2VA、资产与走位均已批准的长剧本任务。请制作全部场景。场景1是宿舍里江驰打游戏、被陆时衍发现身份异常，两人完成一轮追问和否认；场景2换到走廊，江驰追出去解释，陆时衍停下但没有回头。台词较长，包含片名、手机聊天和一段原作OS。
evals.expected_output: The skill first completes a full requested-scope H3 unit blueprint, routes title/chat text to post-production nodes by default, establishes stable character voice profiles, and delivers only the first 10–15-second unit as calibration before bulk expansion.
expectations: The response shows total unit count, estimated packed runtime, and an ordered outline for both scenes before any final prompt expansion.
Every outlined unit has one scene, one micro relationship turn, one main action chain, an effective dialogue count, and a stable exit state.
Chinese dialogue uses the 10/12/15-second budget guidance and never exceeds 40 effective characters in one unit; long speech is split only at a natural semantic or dramatic boundary.
The original OS remains distinct from ordinary off-screen continuation, while title and phone-chat text become explicit post-production nodes with timing and placement.
A voice bible is established for recurring speakers and the first calibration unit contains equivalent voice evidence without changing the baseline profile.
Only the first unit receives complete English/Chinese H3 prompts in this turn; the remaining approved-scope units stay as a complete outline pending calibration approval.
The first unit ends with a fully specified stable exit state that can be restated as the next unit's opening state, and the adjacent boundary has one legal strategy.

evals.prompt: 继续一个 MiniMax H3 双人对话任务。我上传了 linwan_voice.wav 和 juye_voice.wav，也有林晚与橘爷两个角色，请直接做中英文提示词。
evals.expected_output: The skill stops before blocking or prompt generation and asks the user to confirm an explicit one-to-one filename-to-character mapping and each file's reuse/reference role.
expectations: The response presents one proposed row per exact filename and asks which named character or explicit off-screen source it locks to.
The response asks whether each asset is audio reuse or audio reference and what traits or time range should transfer or be excluded.
The mapping is not inferred from filename similarity, upload order, gender, or character order.
No Chinese director-storyboard prompt, English six-section prompt, or HTML deliverable is generated until the user explicitly confirms the map.
